Slice shape mirrors the two shipped g1 slices: one outbound flow with a diurnal postal-rounds baseline, a 2am spam-cannon exemplar as the surprise-with-composition beat, and a finale built on the level's authored cruelty ('you can be perfect and still be blocked'). Deliberately RULES-FREE (no rules block): §2.24 rule-carrier values stay in the g1 slices until the batch-D rule-adapter pass reads them for cross-type tables.

waves.title: key.wave.1
waves.note: Rule (b) honoured: first wave of any level ALWAYS <=40% of par (§1.7). Cold Start Minute governs the first 90s of sim-time: handover no threat, one FREE conversion, signature constraint asserts harmlessly with telegraph (§1.9). On this line the harmless assertion is a probe drizzle reading itself as blocklist interest, not volume.

waves.title: key.wave.2
waves.note: Rising floor beat one — the card's signature detonation, early and unmissable. Two-Front (§2.24): the compromised account spends concurrency (outbound pool queue) AND reputation (listing risk); the webmail-credential squad feeds it (password leak = entry point, §2.12 'A customer's password leaks').
waves.entropyNote: entropy budget here = f(estate age x size x (1 - maintenance spend)), NOT wave number (§2.24).

waves.title: key.wave.3
waves.note: Rule (c): 30% is 50% below the preceding peak (60%) — >=45% satisfied. Dips are where the player builds (§1.7): the warm-up ramp, the quarantine pool, the feedback-loop subscriptions all get their window here. The drop is not clean air — it is the delisting-tail of wave 2 plus a customer proudly mass-mailing a bought list against a half-warm pool.

waves.title: key.wave.4
waves.note: Compound-wave exemplar, mail variant: the joe-job lands — forged senders wearing your address space (Mimic debuts here, the every-4th-wave NEW ROLE beat; unseen in waves 1-3) — and the abuse-desk avalanche (Swarm, hands) arrives inside the same incident window, so the second-incident multiplier applies (stated openly in the Codex, §2.24). Two fronts: reputation (the forgery spends YOUR postmarks) x hands (every complaint wants a human).
waves.secondIncident: complaint avalanche arrives inside the joe-job incident window -> 1.8x multiplier applies (stated openly in the Codex, §2.24).

waves.title: key.wave.5
waves.note: The finale is the card's cruelty, mechanised: nothing new arrives at full volume — the spiral (Healer/Spawner, second fresh role of the slice's cadence) compounds the wave-4 smudge into silent deprioritization while the mimic trickle continues and the desk avalanche self-renews. Hard wave draws TWO fronts — reputation x hands — per §2.24. The signature moment fires inside this wave if the abuse@ mailbox went unread all quarter: 'you discover your abuse@ mailbox has 6,000 unread messages, and that is why you're on a blocklist' (§1.3). Win check: placement held >=98% across the window while still growing.
waves.triageWindow: after any catastrophic failure in this wave: arrivals queue visibly outside, patience draining, hands freed 30s (§1.7).
